resources.string: Verified Safe AI Assistant (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude & OpenRouter)

Brief is a verified, open-source AI assistant — just like ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini — NOT a virus or spyware. It uses Android\'s official Accessibility Overlay solely when you start a task to display your AI cursor and help tap, scroll, or type on screen. Zero root, zero background data collection, hardware-encrypted API keys, and an instant Stop button.
